text:
maria.pm: Quick heads-up — ran the post-demo survey with 12 pilot customers; sharing signals before roadmap sync.

maria.pm: Top asks: 1) small starter SKU for internal teams, 2) prepaid burst/bucket credits, 3) a paid 'priority lane' for tail-latency guarantees.

leah.sales: Hearing same from sales calls. Starter at ~$200/mo would shorten POC cycles. Customers want optional burst credits rather than immediate upgrade.

akshay.eng: Engineering note: prepaid credits are straightforward (token meter + billing hook). Priority lane needs routing + queueing changes. Estimate: credits = 3 sprints; priority lane = additional 6 sprints.

omar.finance: Need to model margins. If starter = $200 with 25k included tokens, overage billed. Burst packs as prepaid bundles (50k / 200k / 1M). Will share sheet — target ~30% margin after infra.

katie.legal: Priority lane implies SLA language. Legal needs fallback and overage clauses. Free trial credits must expire and be non-refundable.

akshay.eng: Two implementation paths: (A) Minimal: API + billing for prepaid credits, console later — 3 sprints. (B) Full: include runtime routing and priority queues — 9 sprints total.

maria.pm: Proposal: Phase 1 = starter SKU + prepaid burst packs (6 weeks). Phase 2 = priority lane add-on (Q3). Phase 1 launch criteria: either 3 pilot commitments OR projected ARR >= $25k/mo + legal T&Cs.

dan.growth: Analytics: 40% of trial teams don't exceed 100k tokens/mo — smaller SKUs likely to convert more trials to paid. Recommend A/B test 'burst pack' CTA.

omar.finance: Sales can give one small burst pack during POC if legal accepts expiration terms. Finance ok with promo if modeled.

akshay.eng: Dev acceptance for Phase 1: API accepts prepaid pack IDs, runtime decrements tokens under concurrency, billing ties credits to invoice, minimal console indicator.

katie.legal: I'll draft a short addendum for starter & credits: expiration, non-refundable, SLA exclusions.

maria.pm: Decision: approve Phase 1 and go with engineering option A (minimal). akshay, please post scope doc and slot sprints.

akshay.eng: Slotting 3 sprints: sprint1 API + billing, sprint2 console + UX, sprint3 hardening & tests. Will post scope EOD tomorrow.

len:marvin-bot: files uploaded: survey-results.csv, pricing-model.xlsx (links in thread).

leah.sales: I'll prepare customer quotes and battlecards for GTM.

omar.finance: I'll finalize margin sheet and share before Friday.

katie.legal: Draft addendum by Thursday.

maria.pm: Schedule final pricing sync Friday 10am. Thanks team! :rocket:
